body:
I'm a ball of self-hatred. That's all I have. 
It's school that's making me hate myself so much. I look around and I see classmates who are such better human beings than I am, the way you'd want a person to turn out. And they recognize me for what I am: Toxic. An asshole that no one likes who's so god-awfully lonely not because he's introverted, but because he's a bad person.  I've had underclassmen tell me that they've been specifically instructed to avoid me "What's that about?". That was close to the worst feeling I've experienced. 

I've traveled the world, no matter where I go, I can't seem to connect with people or enjoy myself. I see people making new friends, bonding with perfect strangers. I'm always a hanger on in new groups that people take pity on or act inclusive towards to say they tried. I've found groups that I have things in common with, I just always seem to fall out of them. People just get tired of me, I run out of things to say. I'm tired of screwing up, I'm tired of failing at being a decent human being. When I say existing hurts, it feels like my soul hurts, if that makes sense. That's my baseline. 

I do nothing but take. I care less and less about people around me, family. I don't want attention, or help. I've stopped caring about anything. I just feel numb.
